def evolve(state: str, offsets: list[int], t: int) -> str:
    n = len(state)
    lamps = int(state[::-1], 2)
    mask = (1 << n) - 1
    shifts = [offset % n for offset in offsets]

    while t:
        if t & 1:
            new_lamps = 0
            for shift in shifts:
                new_lamps ^= (lamps >> shift) | ((lamps << (n - shift)) & mask)
            lamps = new_lamps

        shifts = [(2 * shift) % n for shift in shifts]
        t >>= 1

    return format(lamps, f"0{n}b")[::-1]
